facts.text: Wasskah, also known as the forest moon of Trandosha, was a moon that orbited the planet Trandosha within the Kashyyyk system of the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim.

evidence.quote: Wasskah, also known as the forest moon of Trandosha, was a moon that orbited the planet Trandosha within the Kashyyyk system of the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim.

facts.text: Located in grid coordinates P-9, the moon had islands covered in dense forest.

evidence.quote: Located in grid coordinates P-9, the moon had islands covered in dense forest.

facts.text: Wasskah was owned by a hunting guild led by the Trandoshan Garnac, who used Island Four, one of the moon's islands, as a hunting ground for sentient prey.

evidence.quote: Wasskah was owned by a hunting guild led by the Trandoshan Garnac, who used Island Four, one of the moon's islands, as a hunting ground for sentient prey.

facts.text: Wasskah was a moon of the planet Trandosha, located within the Kashyyyk system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim.

evidence.quote: Wasskah was a moon of the planet Trandosha, located within the Kashyyyk system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim.

facts.text: The moon had a breathable atmosphere to several species, and its surface had islands covered in thorny forests with sandy beaches and massive pointed rock formations.

evidence.quote: The moon had a breathable atmosphere to several species, and its surface had islands covered in thorny forests with sandy beaches and massive pointed rock formations.

facts.text: The moon had a green hue when viewed from space.

evidence.quote: The moon had a green hue when viewed from space.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the secessionist Confederacy of Independent Systems, Wasskah was controlled by the hunting guild led by the Trandoshan Garnac, who used it as a hunting ground for sentient prey.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the secessionist Confederacy of Independent Systems, Wasskah was controlled by the hunting guild led by the Trandoshan Garnac, who used it as a hunting ground for sentient prey.

facts.text: Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano was abducted from the planet Felucia during a battle by the hunter Lo-Taren and brought to Wasskah.

evidence.quote: Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano was abducted from the planet Felucia during a battle by the hunter Lo-Taren and brought to Wasskah.

facts.text: Taken to Island Four and released so she could be hunted down, Tano met with a group of Jedi younglings, led by the distraught Corellian Kalifa.

evidence.quote: Taken to Island Four and released so she could be hunted down, Tano met with a group of Jedi younglings, led by the distraught Corellian Kalifa.

facts.text: As Tano and the younglings fought to stay alive, the Trandoshans brought a new victim to the moon aboard their prisoner ship.

evidence.quote: As Tano and the younglings fought to stay alive, the Trandoshans brought a new victim to the moon aboard their prisoner ship.

facts.text: After an intense fight, the starship Halo arrived, carrying the Wookiee warrior General Tarfful.

evidence.quote: After an intense fight, the starship Halo arrived, carrying the Wookiee warrior General Tarfful.

facts.text: Wasskah was owned by Garnac and his hunting guild, and they had operations set up on Island Four.

evidence.quote: Wasskah was owned by Garnac and his hunting guild, and they had operations set up on Island Four.

facts.text: Their prisoners also dwelt on the island for as long as it took the Trandoshans to hunt them down and kill them.

evidence.quote: Their prisoners also dwelt on the island for as long as it took the Trandoshans to hunt them down and kill them.

facts.text: The Trandoshan bounty hunter Mundokk hailed from Wasskah and operated during the early reign of the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: The Trandoshan bounty hunter Mundokk hailed from Wasskah and operated during the early reign of the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: Island Four was a base of operations for Garnac's hunting guild, and it was here that the hunters let Padawan Tano, Chewbacca, and the younglings loose to be hunted as prey.

evidence.quote: Island Four was a base of operations for Garnac's hunting guild, and it was here that the hunters let Padawan Tano, Chewbacca, and the younglings loose to be hunted as prey.

facts.text: Wasskah first appeared in the twenty-first episode of the third season of the animated television series Star Wars: The Clone Wars, titled "Padawan Lost," which aired on April 1, 2011 on Cartoon Network.

evidence.quote: Wasskah first appeared in the twenty-first episode of the third season of the animated television series Star Wars: The Clone Wars, titled "Padawan Lost," which aired on April 1, 2011 on Cartoon Network.

facts.text: The moon was first identified as "Wasskah" in the episode guide for "Padawan Lost" on StarWars.com.
